vwa.creator: (Creator of LingoIQ)
vwa.pharagrph:
Hi! I’m Yehor, and LingoIQ is my ABA project.

I created this site to make language learning simpler and more structured.
Here, you can find words, grammar rules, and learning tools all in one place.

The site includes a program I developed using Hermann Ebbinghaus’ spaced repetition method to help you remember words efficiently. It’s designed for students, migrants, and anyone eager to learn languages, offering clear structures and easy navigation.

With LingoIQ, I want to give everyone the same opportunity I had: a clear path to mastering a new language.

privacy.title: LingoIQ Privacy Policy
privacy.intro1: Welcome to LingoIQ! We take the privacy of your personal data very seriously and are committed to maintaining transparency regarding how we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy.intro2: This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect when you visit our website or use our language-learning platform, as well as how we process that data.
privacy.sec1Text: We only collect information that is necessary to ensure full platform functionality and to save your learning progress:
privacy.sec1Item1Text: When you register or log in via Firebase Authentication, we receive your email address, username, and selected avatar.
privacy.sec1Item2Text: We store information about the languages you are learning, your vocabulary (glossary), rules, training stages, learned word statistics, and review dates. All of this data is securely stored in a Firebase Firestore database.
privacy.sec1Item3Text: We may use local storage (localStorage) and sessions solely to maintain your authentication state and interface preferences (such as your current interface language or selected mode).
privacy.sec2Title: 2. How Do We Use Your Data?
privacy.sec2Text: The collected information is used exclusively for the following purposes:
privacy.sec2Item1: Creating and managing your account within LingoIQ.
privacy.sec2Item2: Synchronizing and saving your personal progress, glossaries, and rules across different sessions.
privacy.sec2Item3: Providing technical support and enhancing user experience on the platform.
privacy.sec3Item1: We use industry-leading security infrastructure solutions provided by Google Firebase to safeguard your data during transmission and storage.
privacy.sec3Item2: We do not sell, trade, or transfer your personal data to third parties.
privacy.sec4Text: You have full control over your data:
privacy.sec4Item1: You can update your profile details (username, avatar, native language) at any time in your account settings.
privacy.sec4Item2: You have the right to log out or request the complete deletion of your account along with all learning data.
privacy.sec5Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
privacy.sec6Text: If you have any questions, suggestions, or requests regarding the processing of your personal data and privacy, please contact us at:

cookies.title: LingoIQ Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how LingoIQ uses cookies, local storage (localStorage), and similar technologies to ensure smooth and reliable functionality across our website.
cookies.sec1Title: 1. What Are Cookies and Local Storage?
cookies.sec1Item1Text: Small text files placed on your device by a website when you visit its pages.
cookies.sec1Item2Text: A modern web browser feature that enables storing interface settings and data directly in your browser without transmitting them back to the server with every request.
cookies.sec2Title: 2. What Technologies Do We Use and Why?
cookies.sec2Text: LingoIQ relies strictly on strictly necessary technical cookies and localStorage parameters:
cookies.sec2Item1Text: We use session tokens to keep you logged in securely. This prevents you from having to re-enter your password on every page reload or navigation step.
cookies.sec2Item2Text: We store your chosen interface language, active learning stages, and visual settings in your browser's localStorage for a seamless user experience.
cookies.sec3Text1: We utilize Google Firebase infrastructure for user authentication and database management. Google Firebase may set technical cookies required for security and verification purposes.
cookies.sec3Text2: We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies for targeted marketing or ad analytics.
cookies.sec4Text1: You can adjust your browser settings at any time to block or delete cookies and clear localStorage.
cookies.sec4Text2: Please note: If you block essential cookies or clear localStorage, you will be logged out of LingoIQ, and your local interface preferences will be reset.
cookies.sec5Text: We may update this Cookie Policy as necessary. Any updates will be published directly on this page.
cookies.sec6Text: If you have any questions regarding our use of cookies, please reach out to us at:
